8/S0.subgoal: Explain the scope of the lecture and the primary objective of a virtual reality system.

8/S1.subgoal: Distinguish between the technological and psychological issues of VR and introduce the concepts of immersion and presence.

8/S2.subgoal: Explain the definition of immersion and its qualitative dimensions.

8/S3.subgoal: Summarize the key issues of VR and define the concept of presence.

8/S4.subgoal: Compare immersion and presence and explain the overall goal of a VR system.

8/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
